Name: (CP) Fishing for dumies - Easy without skip
Author: mousomashakel
TagLine: Why skip it it you can enjoy it yourself, This makes the fish always at the bottom of the bar in Fishing Mini game using Content Patcher.
Description:
Now you are the pro of fishing. this mod uses Content Patcher to force the fish at the bottom of the bar in Fishing Mini game. which make you have a perfect catch without skipping the game ( or even moving a toe).

Just sit and watch the biggest legendary fish paralyzed and goes into your bag.

This doesn't have any configuration or mod menu.

You may not be able to catch chests well.

It works only with vanilla fish types , Stardew Valley Expanded and More Fish, however if you want to add custom fish from another mods just leave me a comment with mod name .

I'll keep it updated as long as i can.

Tested on :

    Stardew Valley ﻿  v 1.6.14
    SMAPI ﻿﻿﻿v 4.1.7
    Content Patcher ﻿v 2.4.4
    Stardew Valley Expanded 1.15.7

and

    Stardew Valley ﻿  v 1.6.8
    SMAPI ﻿﻿﻿v 4.0.8
    Content Patcher ﻿v 2.3.0
